about: The words of the 3D build's two tester guides that differ from the 2D app's (scripts/copy-guides.py reads this table). Everything else, the pictures included, is the 2D guides as they are: the 3D app lifts the 2D shell 1:1. A paragraph is rewritten in its own text block, with the same size, leading and start, and may not grow past the lines it had (a picture sits under it); `find` is a piece of the old words and must be in the block or the script stops, so a changed 2D guide is noticed. `width` is the paragraph's width in points. Runs are [words, bold]; a \n in the words is a line break.
